value.rationale: Choosing two radii to minimize the exact four-step return/Fourier fourth moment is a natural discrete isotropy and Fourier-flatness design problem. Its all-prime-power solution has nontrivial exceptions at 5 and 9, requires handling a ratio-nine collision affecting q=5,7 and has complete equality classes. It is not merely a restatement of a pre-existing raw intersection-number table.
